note: Export side is factually confirmed by customs bill-of-lading records: real shipments from JNPT to Jebel Ali (UAE), buyer ASCEND ACCESS SYSTEM SCAFFOLDING LLC, latest 2024-11-21, BOL 5778966 — fasteners/spring-adjacent hardware (bolts, washers, tubes, foot rests), not springs as such. Declared HS 732020 (iron/steel helical springs) does not match any of the five visible lines (40169990, 73069019, 39012000, 73181500); per project rules this is NOT a rejection ground — company stays in the base, actual codes are the ones observed above, verdict would be accepted_hs_corrected. Domestic supply evidence (GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders, contracts, annual-report splits) could not be retrieved: DuckDuckGo search returned connection refused on both attempts, volza.com and thecompanycheck.com returned HTTP 403, and no public GST/tender record was visible — so domestic_status is unknown, not 'none_found'; absence of evidence here is a tooling limitation, not proof of no domestic supply. Second slug variant 'satara-springs-mumbai' exists but shows no records in free view. Legal name 'VIKAS SHANKAR POPLE' (claimed) is not corroborated by any source seen — the customs records show only the trade name SATARA SPRINGS; proprietor/legal-entity status, CIN/PAN and revenue/export value are not public in the sources read, so revenue and export volume are null (not estimated).
